notes: Type your hours in the Possible Hours planner — the sliders are gone. Every day is a field now: tap it and type, in school weeks, break weeks, and the Break Calendar.
NEW shift times: tap '+ times' on any day and set a start and end — the hours fill in on their own, with the same 30-minute meal rule as the Paycheck tab for shifts over 6 hours.
NEW Work Log in the Hours tab: save the hours you actually worked each week and look back at your records — most hours in a week, your weekly average, and total take-home logged.
The Break Calendar now counts down to your break — 'Starts in 12 days', 'Happening now', and a countdown tag on every saved break too.
